scene.line: Pretty Petunias! Sugar Plums!
Garden-talents show your green thumbs!
Clap your hands! Scream and shout!
Garden-talents, it's time to sprout!
One, Two, Three, Four!
Animal-talents score with a roar!
Animal-talents flap and flitter!
We take care of every critter!
WAVE your wings, raise a fin...
Water-talents for the win!
Hey there Fairies here's a news flash...
...Water-talents make a big SPLASH!
GO! GO! GO! FIGHT! FIGHT! FIGHT!
We are the talents of LIGHT! LIGHT! LIGHT!
Light-talents shine! You all know!
Come on Fairies! Ready! Set! Glow!
Don't be a Meanie! Don't be a Stinker!
Come on Fairies stand up and TINKER!
Tinker talents are no fools...
...we're the best ones with our tools!
